location: intersection of Whitehorse Road and Springvale Road, Melbourne's eastern suburbs
commercial_building_character: Strong commercial/retail character: site of the City of Whitehorse main office plus large retail; historically home to a large Pacific Brands clothing factory and a brick factory.
verbatim_source_quotes: [Nunawading is] at the intersection of Whitehorse Road and Springvale Road, in Melbourne's eastern suburbs and is the site of the main office of the City of Whitehorse, as well as large retail.
Nunawading is home to a large Pacific Brands clothing factory and a brick factory.
